###Data Loading

```{r}
# Load Main Flight Data
years <- 2004:2008
files <- paste0(years, ".csv")

# Using fread for speed; selecting only necessary columns to save RAM
flights <- rbindlist(lapply(files, function(f) {
  fread(f, select = c("Year", "Month", "DayOfWeek", "DepTime", "CRSDepTime", 
                      "ArrDelay", "TailNum", "Diverted", "Distance", "UniqueCarrier"))
}))

# Load Supplementary Data
airports  <- read_csv("airports.csv",    show_col_types = FALSE)
carriers  <- read_csv("carriers.csv",    show_col_types = FALSE)
planes    <- read_csv("plane-data.csv",  show_col_types = FALSE)

```


a) 

1.Pre-processing
```{r}
delay_summary <- flights %>%
  filter(!is.na(ArrDelay)) %>%
  mutate(DepHour = floor(CRSDepTime / 100)) %>%
  filter(DepHour >= 0, DepHour <= 23) %>%
  group_by(Year, DayOfWeek, DepHour) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgDelay    = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE),
    FlightCount = n(),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(FlightCount >= 30)   
# remove slots with too few flights for reliable estimates
```

2. Summary table
Prints out the best hour and day per year
```{r}
best_times <- delay_summary %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  slice_min(AvgDelay, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, DayOfWeek, DepHour, AvgDelay) %>%
  mutate(
    Day     = c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun")[DayOfWeek],
    AvgDelay = round(AvgDelay, 2)
  )
print(best_times)

```


```{r}
# 3. Plotting the Faceted Heatmap
ggplot(delay_summary, aes(x = DepHour, y = factor(DayOfWeek), fill = AvgDelay)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = -1, name = "Avg Delay (min)") +
  facet_wrap(~Year, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 3)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Flight Delays by Day and Hour (2004-2008)",
    subtitle = "Green = lower delays; Red = higher delays. Cells with < 30 flights removed.",
    x        = "Scheduled Departure Hour (24h)",
    y        = "Day of Week"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

b)

1. Clean plane data
```{r}
plane_age_clean <- planes %>%
  dplyr::select(TailNum = 1, manufacture_year = 9) %>%
  mutate(
    TailNum          = as.character(TailNum),
    manufacture_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(manufacture_year)))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(manufacture_year),
    !manufacture_year %in% c(0, 0000),
    manufacture_year > 1900
  )
```

2. Preare flights
3. Join and compute age ofm flights
```{r}
# 2. Prepare flights (Ensure TailNum is character to match)
flights_clean <- flights %>%
  filter(!is.na(TailNum), TailNum != "",
         !is.na(ArrDelay)) %>%
  mutate(TailNum = as.character(TailNum))

# 3. Join and compute age
age_analysis <- flights_clean %>%
  inner_join(plane_age_clean, by = "TailNum") %>%
  mutate(Age = Year - manufacture_year) %>%
  filter(Age >= 0, Age <= 50)
```


4. Age summary by group
5. Plot the average delay by age group for every year
```{r}
# 4. Summary: avg delay by year and age group
age_summary <- age_analysis %>%
  mutate(AgeGroup = cut(Age,
                        breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50),
                        labels = c("0-5","6-10","11-15","16-20","21-25","26-30","30+"),
                        include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Year, AgeGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgDelay    = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE),
    FlightCount = n(),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

# 5. Plot: avg delay by age group per year
ggplot(age_summary, aes(x = AgeGroup, y = AvgDelay, fill = factor(Year))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title    = "Average Arrival Delay by Plane Age Group and Year",
       subtitle = "Age = flight year − plane manufacture year",
       x = "Plane Age Group (years)", y = "Avg Arrival Delay (mins)", fill = "Year") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


6. Plot trend line for delay vs age per year
```{r}
# 6. Plot
age_analysis %>%
  group_by(Year, Age) %>%
  summarise(AvgDelay = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = AvgDelay, colour = factor(Year), group = Year)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  labs(title    = "Delay Trend vs Plane Age by Year",
       subtitle = "Smoothed trend (LOESS) — positive = delayed on average",
       x = "Plane Age (years)", y = "Avg Arrival Delay (mins)", colour = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

c)

###EDA

```{r}
# Engineer DepHour only (CRSArrTime not in dataset)
flights <- flights %>%
  mutate(DepHour = floor(CRSDepTime / 100))

# Diversion rate by Month, DayOfWeek, DepHour
eda_plots <- list(
  Month     = flights %>% group_by(Year, Month)     %>% summarise(Rate = mean(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(factor(Month),     Rate, colour = factor(Year), group = Year)) + geom_line() + geom_point(),
  DayOfWeek = flights %>% group_by(Year, DayOfWeek) %>% summarise(Rate = mean(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(factor(DayOfWeek), Rate, colour = factor(Year), group = Year)) + geom_line() + geom_point(),
  DepHour   = flights %>% group_by(Year, DepHour)   %>% summarise(Rate = mean(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(factor(DepHour),   Rate, colour = factor(Year), group = Year)) + geom_line() + geom_point()
)

# Print EDA plots with shared formatting
iwalk(eda_plots, ~ print(
  .x + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
       labs(title = paste("Diversion Rate by", .y), x = .y, y = "Rate", colour = "Year") +
       theme_minimal()
))

# Diversion rate by Carrier
flights %>%
  group_by(Year, UniqueCarrier) %>%
  summarise(Rate = mean(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE), Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(Count > 1000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(UniqueCarrier, Rate), Rate, fill = factor(Year))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(title = "Diversion Rate by Carrier", x = "Carrier", y = "Rate", fill = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

# Point-biserial correlations
tibble(
  Feature     = c("Month", "DayOfWeek", "DepHour", "Distance"),
  Correlation = sapply(c("Month", "DayOfWeek", "DepHour", "Distance"),
                       function(x) cor(as.numeric(flights[[x]]), flights$Diverted, use = "complete.obs"))
) %>% arrange(desc(abs(Correlation))) %>% print()
```

### Model Pipeline
to train/test split per year

```{r}
years <- sort(unique(flights$Year))

results <- map(years, function(yr) {

  # Prepare & stratified sample
  df <- flights %>%
    filter(Year == yr) %>%
    dplyr::select(Diverted, Month, DayOfWeek, DepHour, Distance, UniqueCarrier) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(Diverted      = factor(Diverted, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
           UniqueCarrier = factor(UniqueCarrier)) %>%
    group_by(Diverted) %>% sample_frac(0.20) %>% ungroup()

  # 80/20 train/test split
  idx      <- createDataPartition(df$Diverted, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_df <- df[ idx, ]
  test_df  <- df[-idx, ]

  # Fit on training set only
  fit <- speedglm(Diverted ~ Month + DayOfWeek + DepHour + Distance + UniqueCarrier,
                  data = train_df, family = binomial())

  # Evaluate on test set
  probs <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response")
  preds <- factor(ifelse(probs > 0.5, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  cm    <- confusionMatrix(preds, test_df$Diverted, positive = "Yes")
  auc   <- as.numeric(auc(roc(as.integer(test_df$Diverted == "Yes"), probs, quiet = TRUE)))

  cat("Year:", yr, "| Accuracy:", round(cm$overall["Accuracy"], 4), "| AUC:", round(auc, 4), "\n")

  # Return coefficients + performance
  tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Year     = yr,
           Accuracy = cm$overall["Accuracy"],
           AUC      = auc)

}) %>% bind_rows()
```

3. Visualise results
```{r}
# Numeric feature coefficients across years
results %>%
  filter(term %in% c("Month", "DayOfWeek", "DepHour", "Distance")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(Year), estimate, colour = term, group = term)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  facet_wrap(~term, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Logistic Regression Coefficients Across Years",
       x = "Year", y = "Log-Odds Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Carrier coefficients as heatmap
results %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "UniqueCarrier")) %>%
  mutate(Carrier = str_remove(term, "UniqueCarrier")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(Year), Carrier, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "tomato", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Carrier Coefficients Across Years", x = "Year", fill = "Log-Odds") +
  theme_minimal()

# Model performance across years
results %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Accuracy, AUC) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(Year), Value, colour = Metric, group = Metric)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Test Set Performance Across Years", x = "Year", y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
```
